verses.arabicText: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānim-mubīn
verses.translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.

verses.arabicText: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīn
verses.translation: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

verses.arabicText: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābum-maʿlūm
verses.translation: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

verses.arabicText: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūn
verses.translation: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi dh-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūn
verses.translation: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

verses.arabicText: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina ṣ-ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

verses.arabicText: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idham-munẓarīn
verses.translation: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nazzalnā dh-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūn
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīn
verses.translation: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yatīhim mir-rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.translation: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīn
verses.translation: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

verses.arabicText: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīn
verses.translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bābam-mina s-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūn
verses.translation: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

verses.arabicText: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmum-masḥūrūn
verses.translation: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad jaʿalnā fī s-samāi burūjaw-wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīn
verses.translation: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

verses.arabicText: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānir-rajīm
verses.translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Illā mani is'taraqa s-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābum-mubīn
verses.translation: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayim-mawzūn
verses.translation: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha wamal-lastum lahu birāziqīn
verses.translation: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

verses.arabicText: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-im-min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarim-maʿlūm
verses.translation: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

verses.arabicText: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-arsalnā r-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina s-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīn
verses.translation: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūn
verses.translation: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīn
verses.translation: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīm
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālim-min ḥama-im-masnūn
verses.translation: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min-nāri s-samūm
verses.translation: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharam-min ṣalṣālim-min ḥama-im-masnūn
verses.translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi mir-rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verses.translation: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.arabicText: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verses.translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

verses.arabicText: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ib'līsa abā ay-yakūna maʿa s-sājidīn
verses.translation: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa s-sājidīn
verses.translation: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lam akul-li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālim-min ḥama-im-masnūn
verses.translation: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīm
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi d-dīn
verses.translation: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

verses.arabicText: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.transliteration: Ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verses.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīm
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīn
verses.translation: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

verses.arabicText: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.transliteration: Lahā sabʿatu abwābil-likulli bābim-min'hum juz'om-maqsūm
verses.translation: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātiw-waʿuyūn
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

verses.arabicText: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīn
verses.translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

verses.arabicText: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururim-mutaqābilīn
verses.translation: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

verses.arabicText: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabuw-wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīn
verses.translation: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

verses.arabicText: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru r-raḥīm
verses.translation: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīm
verses.translation: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

verses.arabicText: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīm
verses.translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūn
verses.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīm
verses.translation: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā am-massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūn
verses.translation: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takum-mina l-qāniṭīn
verses.translation: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla wamay-yaqnaṭu mir-raḥmati rabbihi illā ḍ-ḍālūn
verses.translation: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmim-muj'rimīn
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

verses.arabicText: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīn
verses.translation: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā jāa āla lūṭil-l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla innakum qawmum-munkarūn
verses.translation: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūn
verses.translation: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

verses.arabicText: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūn
verses.translation: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

verses.arabicText: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿim-mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥaduw-wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūn
verses.translation: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

verses.arabicText: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿum-muṣ'biḥīn
verses.translation: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūn
verses.translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūn
verses.translation: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

verses.arabicText: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūn
verses.translation: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīn
verses.translation: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

verses.arabicText: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūn
verses.translation: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhathumu ṣ-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīn
verses.translation: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

verses.arabicText: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.transliteration: Fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratam-min sijjīl
verses.translation: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyātil-lil'mutawassimīn
verses.translation: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahā labisabīlim-muqīm
verses.translation: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika laāyatal-lil'mu'minīn
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

verses.arabicText: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīn
verses.translation: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.

verses.arabicText: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmim-mubīn
verses.translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīn
verses.translation: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.

verses.arabicText: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīn
verses.translation: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

verses.arabicText: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīn
verses.translation: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhathumu ṣ-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīn
verses.translation: But the shriek seized them at early morning.

verses.arabicText: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.translation: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqnā s-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna s-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi ṣ-ṣafḥa l-jamīl
verses.translation: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ātaynāka sabʿam-mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.

verses.arabicText: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājam-min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīn
verses.translation: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers

verses.arabicText: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Waqul innī anā n-nadhīru l-mubīn
verses.translation: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

verses.arabicText: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīn
verses.translation: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīn
verses.translation: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

verses.arabicText: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.translation: About what they used to do.

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīn
verses.translation: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīn
verses.translation: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn
verses.translation: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

verses.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakum-mina s-sājidīn
verses.translation: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

verses.arabicText: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.transliteration: Wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīn
verses.translation: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
